# AGENTS.md — exo

Guidance for AI coding agents working in this repo. **Read this before touching code.**

## TL;DR — Pre-Commit Checklist (REQUIRED)

CI fails if any of these fail. Run them all before committing:

```bash
uv run basedpyright && uv run ruff check && nix fmt && uv run pytest
```

- `basedpyright` must report **0 errors** (strict mode).
- `ruff check` must pass.
- `nix fmt` must be applied — stage any files it rewrites.
- `pytest` must pass (slow tests excluded by default; use `-m ""` to include them).

CI runs `nix flake check`, which also runs Rust tests.

## Project Overview

exo is a distributed AI inference system that clusters multiple devices to run large language models. Inference backend is MLX; peer-to-peer networking is zenoh.

## Build & Run

```bash
# Dashboard build is REQUIRED before running exo
cd dashboard && npm install && npm run build && cd ..

# Run exo (master + worker, API at http://localhost:52415)
uv run exo
